description: This file defines the LicenseDao class, which provides data access operations for License entities in the OrangeHRM system, including saving, retrieving by ID or name, listing with filters, counting, deleting, and checking for existing license names.

classes.name: LicenseDao
classes.description: Data access object for License entity, enabling CRUD and query operations for licenses in the OrangeHRM system.

methods.name: saveLicense
methods.description: Persists a License entity to the database and returns the saved entity.

methods.name: getLicenseById
methods.description: Retrieves a License entity by its ID, returning null if not found.

methods.name: getLicenseByName
methods.description: Retrieves a License entity matching the given name, trims whitespace.

methods.name: getLicenseList
methods.description: Returns an array of License entities based on search filter parameters, using pagination.

methods.name: getLicenseListPaginator
methods.description: Returns a Paginator object configured with search filters and pagination for licenses.

methods.name: getLicenseCount
methods.description: Returns the count of License entities that match the provided search filters.

methods.name: deleteLicenses
methods.description: Deletes multiple License entities based on an array of IDs.

methods.name: isExistingLicenseName
methods.description: Checks if a license with the given name already exists.

methods.name: getExistingLicenseIds
methods.description: Returns an array of license IDs that exist from a list of IDs.
